description: Every activity in a period, with the main fields from Garmin's activity list under Garmin's own names and values: distance (m), duration (s), speed (m/s), grade-adjusted speed, elevation, heart rate, cadence, power and power curve (maxAvgPower_<seconds>), TSS, intensity factor, training effect and load, fastest splits (fastestSplit_<metres>, in seconds) and seconds per heart rate and power zone. Up to 366 days per call.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

sport.description: Only activities of this sport, by Garmin activity type. Omit for all.
